subject: Post-call recap & request: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive to advance pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@opticart.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & request: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive to advance pilot

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and clear next steps to keep the pilot moving: 

Summary (30s):
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood to reduce inference latency for OptiCart search recommendations and lower per-token cost for peak traffic.
- Key constraints: <100ms P95, ability to pin model variants, and ADT-driven data residency questions for EU shoppers.
- Decision-makers: You (Head of Data/ML), Ruth Lee (CTO) for final architecture sign-off, and procurement for contract terms.

Open items we agreed to cover in the next meeting (VP/CTO + technical deep dive):
1) High-level architecture alignment (how Redwood routes to hosted vs dedicated).
2) Performance baseline and demo on OptiCart-like query patterns.
3) Quantization/throughput tradeoffs and cost estimates for projected Q4 traffic.
4) Security/compliance bullets (SSO, audit logs, retention).

Can we lock a 45–60m slot (VP/CTO + engineering deep dive)? Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wed Mar 28, 9:30–10:30am
- Thu Mar 29, 1:00–2:00pm
- Fri Mar 30, 11:00am–12:00pm

If none of those work, send 2 slots that work for you and Ruth and I’ll align. For the deep dive I’ll bring Aditya (infra lead) to walk the runtime and run a short demo. Marissa (cc'd) will help enable procurement prep.

Attached: discovery notes from today's call (two pages) and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) draft we can adjust.

Proposed attendees:
- Samir Patel — Head of Data/ML (OptiCart)
- Ruth Lee — CTO (OptiCart)
- Chloe Martin — Account Executive (Redwood)
- Aditya Rao — Staff Inference Engineer (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole — Sales Ops / Procurement Liaison (Redwood)

Thanks,

Chloe Martin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0126

Attachments: OptiCart-discovery-notes.pdf (summary, ~2 pages); OPTC-472-MAP.xlsx (mutual-action plan stub)

Chloe —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed 3/28 at 9:30am PDT works best for me; I’ve looped Ruth here and she asked whether that slot is still available. High-level requests from our side before we lock:
- Short (5–10m) exec-level intro for Ruth to see the business impact.
- 30–40m technical deep dive focusing on latency tail behavior and on-prem/VPC options.
- A heads-up on any hard limits around retention/PII handling.

Also, can you send a one-paragraph agenda we can attach to Ruth's calendar? Our procurement person (procurement@opticart.ai) may be included later — I’ll flag the meeting to them.
